newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas sold Elf shares at 555 Ffr - source.
newsitem.headline: Paribas sold Elf shares at 555 Ffr - source.

text.p: Financial group Paribas sold 1.98 million shares in energy group Elf Aquitaine at 555 francs each, a source close to the transaction said on Friday.
Market sources earlier had spoken of a price of 557 francs.
A spokeswoman for Paribas, who declined to confirm the sale price, said the group no longer held any shares in Elf.
The 1.98 million Elf shares, sold earlier in New York, represented 0.73 percent of Elf's capital.
Paribas had bought into Elf at the time of the oil company's privatisation in 1993.

The decision to divest reflect "our strategy to invest in mid-sized firms with strong potential and not retain a number of small stakes in very big groups," a Paribas source said. "It's also part of the routine portfolio rotation."
